interval_timeline.grade_note: The L2CAP Connection Parameter Update Request (0x12) on CID 0x0005 was RECEIVED by the phone, therefore it was originated by the peripheral. The phone then applied it with an HCI LE Connection Update and answered with an Accepted (0x0000) L2CAP response. Causality is direct and ordered: 4420 (request) -> 4421 (apply) -> 4422 (accept) -> 4426 (complete).

deviation_to_note.explanation: The peripheral asked for 7.50 ms (6 x 1.25 ms) and the phone answered 'Accepted' but then programmed 11.25 ms (9 x 1.25 ms). 11.25 ms / 1.25 ms = 9, and 9 is the lowest HCI connection interval value Android's GATT stack permits for peripheral-originated requests (AOSP constant BTM_BLE_CONN_INT_MIN_LIMIT). The clamp itself is observed in the stream; the reason is inferred from AOSP behaviour and was NOT verified by reading the AOSP constant in this session.
deviation_to_note.supporting_public_evidence: AOSP commit titles referencing BTM_BLE_CONN_INT_MIN_LIMIT (e.g. 'Allow BTM_BLE_CONN_INT_MIN_LIMIT override by sysprop') confirm the constant exists; its value 0x0009 was not read verbatim here.

app_code_analysis.answer: NO. The application code does not explicitly request any connection-interval profile. It never calls requestConnectionPriority, never uses CONNECTION_PRIORITY_HIGH/BALANCED/LOW_POWER, never calls setPreferredPhy, and never passes a connection_priority option to connect(). The only GATT configuration the app performs is requestMtu (23, then 512 -> negotiated 64) and service/notification discovery.
app_code_analysis.explicit_warning: There is NO evidence that the app requested 11.25 ms. The only 11.25 ms event in the capture was requested by the PERIPHERAL and clamped up by Android's GATT stack. Claiming app-requested 11.25 ms would be false.

conclusions: Of the four interval states, exactly one (11.25 ms) was initiated by the peripheral via an L2CAP LE-signalling Connection Parameter Update Request; the phone accepted it and applied it.
The other three (30 ms at connect, 7.5 ms, 30 ms) are host-stack-initiated HCI LE Connection Update commands with no L2CAP negotiation and no app API call: STACK_AUTOMATIC.
The app does not request any interval profile. The 11.25 ms value is an Android-side clamp of the peripheral's 7.50 ms request, not an app preference.

The peripheral's own preference (7.50 ms) is independently corroborated: its GAP Peripheral Preferred Connection Parameters characteristic (0x2a04) reads 0600 0600 0000 c800, i.e. min 6 / max 6 (7.5 ms), latency 0, timeout 200 (2000 ms) - see the harness session capture, which read exactly that value.
